info.title: Snaglist implemented platform API
info.description: Implemented v2 foundation, not the complete unified-platform API. New snag responses include canonical calendar deadlines and exact decimal costs; nested legacy timestamp/number fields are compatibility mirrors. Complete field/graph parity, evidence/workflow/private media, reports/jobs, company billing and account deletion remain under implementation. V1 recovery endpoints remain outside this contract.

browserSession.name: __Host-snaglist_session
browserSession.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, host-only. Unsafe calls require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

nativeBearer.description: Signature, expiry, subject/user UUID, active lifecycle and revocation version checked.

ProjectGrant.description: Role must be explicit: null removes access. Revision 0 creates only when no grant or retained tombstone exists. Removed rows retain increasing revisions. An old permission edit cannot recreate removed access.

canonical.description: Authoritative exact dates/costs. The nested snag retains compatibility timestamp/number mirrors. Missing only in stored pre-parity candidate receipts or snapshots: refetch before presenting/editing these fields.

dueDate.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

costEstimate.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

actualCost.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

anyOf.description: Exact decimal major currency units, 0–1000000000, up to six decimal places. Do not parse into a JavaScript float for edits. Null means unset; "0" means a recorded zero.
